summary: Frontend-only test of mobile touch-scroll fix for portaled dropdowns inside modals (TeamSelect Popover, shadcn Select, DropdownMenu). Emulated mobile in Playwright Chromium (390x844 isMobile+hasTouch, Pixel-5 UA; plus 667x375 landscape) using real CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent swipes. WebKit/iPhone emulation NOT available in this environment (/pw-browsers only has chromium) -> iOS Safari not verified. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL bug: components/ui/dropdown-menu.jsx used isolateScroll/MENU_SCROLL without importing them -> 'ReferenceError: isolateScroll is not defined' crashed the Events page (/eventi) and EventPipeline on every load. After the fix, all tested flows pass.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: missing import of isolateScroll and MENU_SCROLL from @/lib/menuScroll -> runtime ReferenceError on pages that use DropdownMenu (Events.jsx, EventPipeline.jsx). Events page crashed before fix (pageerror 'isolateScroll is not defined'). ESLint did not flag this no-undef, so the dev build looked 'Compiled with warnings' only.

Turni > Aggiungi turno > shift-team TeamSelect: opens upward, footer 'Aggiungi nuovo Team' visible, touch scroll 0 -> 223

Select shift-event (24 TEST events): opens upward when trigger in lower half (data-side=top, top 4 / bottom 433), opens downward when trigger near top (data-side=bottom), touch swipe scrolls Radix viewport both directions (345 -> 0 -> 325), dialog not scrolled, option selection works
DropdownMenu (Events page 'Azioni', mobile): after fix opens, flips upward near bottom (side=top, 538-767 within 844), 7 items
Dialog itself touch-scrollable (scrollHeight 1111 > clientHeight 791, scrollTop 0 -> 319); Salva/Annulla (person-detail-save/cancel, shift-save/cancel) reachable
mobile_landscape_667x375: Dialog touch-scrolls; shift-team popover flips up and fits (15-274 of 375), touch scroll works

rca of the issue: Original bug: Radix Dialog uses react-remove-scroll which cancels touchmove/wheel outside the dialog DOM; portaled Popover/Select/DropdownMenu content is outside, so touch scroll was blocked. Fix (stopPropagation of touchmove/wheel on menu content + available-height max-h + collisionPadding) verified working in Chromium touch emulation. Regression introduced by the fix: dropdown-menu.jsx referenced isolateScroll/MENU_SCROLL without import -> ReferenceError crashing Events/EventPipeline pages; fixed by adding the import.
